description: Dose-response on the one weakly supported zero-time lever. E100 multiplied the 32 px-phase filter Muon lr by 1.25 (+0.09 pp off-seed, distinct scored mean 0.7538). Base: E100 code. Change only that 32 px-phase factor, from 1.25 to 1.5 (0.36 at the same schedule position; the floor-hold covers the same samples, at 1.5x). The head keeps 0.5x and scales along. Nothing else changes, and the phase-keyed 0-d tensor means nothing recompiles. Decide on off-seed seeds 3-26 in >=2 fresh processes against the E100 baseline, plus two distinct scored samples.
